questions.question: Which categories should the monthly email keep?

options.label: Top few by total
options.adds: Keep only the categories with the largest totals this month.

options.label: Fixed short list
options.adds: Keep only the categories on a fixed list I give you.

options.label: Hide empty ones
options.adds: Hide categories with no entries this month instead of cutting by size.

rewriteBeforeAnswers: The monthly email lists every category, and people stop reading halfway. Cut the category list down so the email is short enough to read through. Change only the monthly email's category list, not the other emails or the category data. Don't add tests or docs. Done when the monthly email renders with the shorter list and I can see a sample of its output.
